required_fields.worker_handle: exact activation handle as a non-empty string
required_fields.implementation_plan_action: create when ready_for_implementation; omit when awaiting_input
required_fields.inputs_consumed: non-empty list of strings; include UPSTREAM-001 or the exact normalized_evidence.md path
required_fields.interface_contract: null when interface_change is false; canonical object when true
required_fields.confidence: object with non-empty level, basis, and limits strings

blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.decision_type: business, scope, ownership, incompatible_alternatives, or indispensable_evidence
blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.question: non-empty string
blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.fix_implications: at least two materially different non-empty strings
blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.evidence_refs: non-empty list of current-run evidence references
blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.invalidates_supported_change: boolean; true only for affirmative observed competing evidence
blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.contradicting_evidence_refs: required non-empty list when invalidates_supported_change is true
blocking_unknown_when_awaiting_input.observed_competing_boundaries: required non-empty list when invalidates_supported_change is true; each entry has boundary, affirmative observation, and evidence_refs. Missing observations, unavailable release mapping, and possible code paths do not qualify.

interface_readiness: Readiness requires complete semantic request/response behavior, absence semantics, compatibility precedence, rollout, and a selected remediation boundary. Wire names may remain explicitly proposed when exact-name confirmation is recorded as an implementation-plan check.
readiness_boundary_guard: When Contract Delta shows field-keyed baseline content reduced to scalar or message-only destination input, a ready result must include the upstream producer/request boundary, an affirmative field-preservation change, and explicit response-side field identity (field property, key, identifier, or equivalent qualification); a downstream-only plan, explicitly unchanged scalar request, or unqualified response is not ready. Do not clear a candidate boundary/change merely to pass the awaiting_input guard.
